faq_heading: Maillardville condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Maillardville. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Maillardville, Coquitlam: 34 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 5 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 5 of 23 Coquitlam communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Maillardville fell from 46 in June to 34 in October (−26.1%), and 18 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 4.4% of Coquitlam’s 779 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Maillardville?
Maillardville also had 15 houses listed and 1 sold in October, against 34 condos and townhomes listed. The Maillardville houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Maillardville home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

17 townhomes sold in Maillardville with a median price of $763,000 (the middle half sold between $615,000 and $1,098,000), taking a median of 25 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $608 per square foot, a median year built of 1998 and a median strata fee of $380 a month. 15 condos sold in Maillardville with a median price of $528,000 (the middle half sold between $410,000 and $596,000), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 99.3% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $633 per square foot, a median year built of 1998 and a median strata fee of $402 a month.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Maillardville?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 34 condos and townhomes listed in Maillardville. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Maillardville a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Maillardville had a sales ratio of 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Maillardville from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 18 condos and townhomes sold in Maillardville over those 5 months, out of 596 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Maillardville sell for?
faq.a: 17 townhomes sold in Maillardville between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $763,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Maillardville?
faq.a: The median was 25 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.2% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
